scope: Rows 21–39 of Makati Facts and Figures 2020 jeepney-route inventory; published number 36 is absent. Research only; no route assets added.
methodology: Route-corridor continuity is evaluated separately from association/operator continuity.
Current services sharing only part of a historical route do not prove the old through-route survives.
A modernized endpoint or route extension is recorded as a successor/change, not as an unchanged match.
No linear route is represented as a single point.
